top_findings: Live Vercel/Next deployment does not match the checked-out Vite/Hostinger repository.
Declared live image sitemap is malformed XML due to unescaped ampersands.
Repository meta CSP conflicts with inline GTM/GA snippets and .htaccess CSP.
33 of 49 live titles and 39 of 49 live descriptions exceed the audit length guidance.
31 live pages emit deprecated HowTo JSON-LD and 35 lack social preview images.
quick_wins: Align CSP policies and verify analytics loading.
Rewrite the worst title and description outliers.
Add reusable social preview images to missing templates.
Remove HowTo JSON-LD from affected live templates.
